metadata.name: lending_amm
metadata.description: A Pipeline strategy whose markets lend one side to Kamino Lend and trade from their own vaults

instructions.name: add_liquidity
docs: Adds both mints to a market for LP shares; the first deposit opens it.

accounts.name: lp
docs: The LP, who pays for their shares account if it is missing.

accounts.name: lp_token_0
docs: authority.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token, the LP mint's program.

accounts.name: reserve
docs: The Kamino reserve the lent mint lends to, read-only, from which the lent side is valued.

instructions.name: lock_lp
docs: Moves `amount` of the LP's shares into the market's lock account, for good.

accounts.name: lp
docs: The LP, who pays for the lock account if it is missing.

accounts.name: lp_shares
docs: The token account of the LP mint the shares come from, which the LP owns.

accounts.name: lock_account
docs: mint; created here if missing.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token, the LP mint's program.

instructions.name: pipeline_init_market
docs: Creates a market. `data` is the Borsh-encoded [`InitParams`].

accounts.name: market_signer
docs: The router's market PDA for this market state.

accounts.name: market_state
docs: and created by the handler.

accounts.name: payer
docs: A router PDA holding the SOL the creator allowed for setup. Rent comes from it; the
router returns what is left to the creator.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token, which owns the lent mint, the collateral mint and the LP mint.

instructions.name: pipeline_market_info
docs: Reports the market's mints, vaults and exact-out support.

instructions.name: pipeline_quote
docs: Prices a trade without changing anything.

accounts.name: output_mint
docs: the lent mint before passing it on as klend's liquidity mint.

instructions.name: pipeline_resolve_accounts
docs: Lists the strategy accounts a swap needs, after the router's ten fixed ones.

accounts.name: output_mint
docs: the lent mint before passing it on as klend's liquidity mint.

instructions.name: pipeline_seed_liquidity
docs: For a launchpad graduating a token: creates a market at the PDA `["seeded", seeder,
other_mint, lent_mint, lp_fee_bps]` with the creation parameters in `request.data`,
makes its first deposit of `request.amounts` from the seeder's escrows, mints the shares
to the LP recipient's associated token account for the LP mint, and returns
`SeedResult`. The caller then records the market with the router.

accounts.name: seeder
docs: A PDA of the calling program, signing; it owns the escrows and becomes the seeder.

accounts.name: market_state
docs: checked and created by [`NewMarket`].

accounts.name: payer
docs: A system account holding the SOL the caller allows for rent.

accounts.name: lp_recipient
docs: lock them.

accounts.name: escrow_0
docs: authority.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token, which owns the lent mint, the collateral mint and the LP mint.

accounts.name: recipient_shares
docs: lock account when the LP recipient is the vault authority.

accounts.name: reserve
docs: The Kamino reserve the lent mint lends to, read-only, checked before the first deposit
as `add_liquidity` checks it.

instructions.name: pipeline_swap
docs: Settles a trade the router sends.

accounts.name: market_signer
docs: The router's market PDA; compared with the market state's `market_signer`.

instructions.name: rebalance
docs: Moves the buffer back to its target by depositing into Kamino or redeeming from it,
when its share of the lent side has left its band. Anyone may call it.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. Read-only, so nothing can be taken from it beyond the transaction fee.

instructions.name: remove_lent_side
docs: Burns `lp` of the LP's shares for their part of the buffer, in the lent mint, and of the
cTokens, in kind, leaving the other side's part to the LPs who stay: the way out when the
other mint's freeze authority or transfer hook stops `remove_liquidity`.

accounts.name: lp
docs: The LP, who pays for their cToken account if it is missing.

accounts.name: lp_shares
docs: The token account of the LP mint the shares are burned from, which the LP owns.

accounts.name: lp_token_0
docs: program checks it.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: The reserve's collateral (cToken) mint, which the market recorded.

accounts.name: lp_ctoken
docs: and created at the LP's expense if missing.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token, the program of the LP mint, the lent mint and the cToken mint.

instructions.name: remove_liquidity
docs: Burns `lp` of the LP's shares for their part of the other side, the buffer and the
cTokens: in cash, the cTokens' part redeemed from Kamino and paid in the lent mint, or in
kind, paid as cTokens with no Kamino account read or called.

accounts.name: lp
docs: The LP, who burns their shares and pays for their cToken account if an in-kind removal
creates it.

accounts.name: lp_shares
docs: The token account of the LP mint the shares are burned from, which the LP owns.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: The reserve's collateral (cToken) mint, an SPL Token mint, read-only, so an in-kind
removal never write-locks the mint every Kamino user of the reserve shares; a cash removal
passes it again, writable, among the Kamino accounts.

accounts.name: lp_ctoken
docs: removal pays the cTokens, created there if missing; checked only in kind, since a cash
removal never touches it.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token, the program of the LP mint, the lent mint and every cToken mint.

accounts.name: klend_program
docs: For a removal in cash, the lent mint's Kamino accounts, each checked before any is
passed to klend ([`KaminoAccounts::check`]); left out in kind.

accounts.name: reserve_collateral_mint
docs: supply; checked against the lent mint's entry in `LENT_MINTS`.

errors.name: BadInitData

errors.name: WrongAccount

errors.name: WrongMarketState

errors.name: EqualMints

errors.name: NotAMint

errors.name: MintExtensionNotAllowed

errors.name: WrongTokenProgram
errors.msg: The token program is not the mint's

errors.name: BadLentIndex

errors.name: WrongCollateralMint

errors.name: ExactOutNotSupported

errors.name: FirstDepositTooSmall

errors.name: ZeroShares
errors.msg: The deposit would mint no shares

errors.name: BelowMinLp
errors.msg: The deposit would mint fewer shares than min_lp

errors.name: LentValueUnavailable
errors.msg: The market holds cTokens, which this version cannot value yet

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: EmptySide

errors.name: ReserveWrongAddress
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve is not the one the market's lent mint lends to

errors.name: ReserveNotKamino
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve is not owned by Kamino Lend

errors.name: ReserveWrongSize
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve does not have a reserve's size

errors.name: ReserveWrongDiscriminator
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve does not carry a reserve's discriminator

errors.name: ReserveWrongLendingMarket
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve belongs to another lending market

errors.name: ReserveWrongLiquidityMint
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve lends another mint

errors.name: ReserveWrongCollateralMint
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve has another collateral mint

errors.name: ReserveSupplyInvalid
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve's total supply cannot be computed

errors.name: LendingMarketWrongAccount
errors.msg: The Kamino lending market account is not the lent mint's lending market

errors.name: WithinBand
errors.msg: The buffer's share of the lent side is inside its band: there is nothing to rebalance

errors.name: BelowMinRebalance
errors.msg: The move is smaller than the lent mint's MIN_REBALANCE, so it is skipped

errors.name: KaminoAccountWrong
errors.msg: A Kamino account is not the one the lent mint's reserve names

errors.name: RedeemAccountsMissing
errors.msg: The trade needs a redeem from Kamino, but was built without the redeem accounts: resolve its accounts again

errors.name: RedeemPaidShort
errors.msg: Kamino's redeem paid the market less than the swap's shortfall

errors.name: ZeroRemoval
errors.msg: The removal would burn no LP shares or pay out nothing

errors.name: NotEnoughShares
errors.msg: The removal burns more LP shares than the market has minted

errors.name: BelowMinOther
errors.msg: The removal would pay out less of the other mint than min_other

errors.name: BelowMinLent
errors.msg: The removal would pay out less of the lent mint than min_lent

errors.name: KaminoAccountsMissing
errors.msg: A removal in cash needs the lent mint's Kamino accounts: add them, or remove in kind

errors.name: KaminoCannotPay
errors.msg: Kamino cannot pay the cTokens' part right now: remove in kind

errors.name: ZeroLock
errors.msg: Locking needs at least one LP share

errors.name: KaminoStopped
errors.msg: Kamino redeems nothing right now (reserve or lending market emergency mode, or a deprecated reserve): rebalance refuses

errors.name: KaminoDepositsBlocked
errors.msg: Kamino blocks cToken deposits into the reserve: rebalance skips the deposit

errors.name: ReserveDeprecated
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve is deprecated after a total write-off: adding liquidity is refused, and removal is in kind only

errors.name: RebalanceNotAlone
errors.msg: rebalance must be called directly, once per transaction, beside nothing but compute budget instructions and klend's refresh_reserve or refresh_reserves_batch

errors.name: BadSeedAmounts
errors.msg: SeedRequest.amounts must hold exactly one amount for each of the market's two mints

errors.name: ReserveStale
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve's stored rate is too old to value the market's cTokens: put klend's refresh_reserve first in the same transaction

errors.name: ReserveWrongVersion
errors.msg: The Kamino reserve's version is one this program was not written for: quotes, swaps, adding and rebalance are refused, and removal is in kind only

errors.name: BelowMinCtokens
errors.msg: The removal would pay out fewer cTokens than min_ctokens

types.name: InitParams
docs: `create_market`'s `init_data`: these fields, Borsh-encoded in this order.

fields.name: lent_index
docs: Which of the two mints, 0 or 1, is lent; it must be on the cluster's `LENT_MINTS`.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: The LP fee in basis points, at most `MAX_LP_FEE_BPS`.

types.name: LendingAmmMarket
docs: A lending AMM market: the market state account the router records and passes to every
call.

fields.name: version
docs: [`STATE_VERSION`].

fields.name: bump
docs: The bump of the market state's own PDA.

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: The bump of the vault authority PDA.

fields.name: lent_index
docs: The mint index (0 or 1) that is lent; the other is never lent.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: The LP fee, in basis points of every swap's input; it stays in the market.

fields.name: withdraw_mode
docs: Set while the market is in withdraw mode (docs/spec/lending-pool.md, "Withdraw mode").

fields.name: mints
docs: The two mints, in the creator's order.

fields.name: vaults
docs: The vault for each mint, in the same order; the lent mint's vault holds the buffer.

fields.name: market_signer
docs: The router's market PDA for this market state, the only caller allowed to swap.

fields.name: lp_mint
docs: The market's LP mint.

fields.name: ctoken_account
docs: The token account holding the market's cTokens.

fields.name: reserve
docs: The Kamino reserve the lent side is deposited into, from `LENT_MINTS`.

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: That reserve's collateral (cToken) mint.

fields.name: seeder
docs: For a market created by `pipeline_seed_liquidity`, the seeder whose address scopes
it; the default key for a market created through the router.

fields.name: reserves
docs: What the market has recorded in each vault, by mint index: the other side's reserve
`R`, and on the lent side the buffer `B`. Tokens sent to a vault any other way are
donations, never counted.

fields.name: ctokens
docs: The cTokens the market has recorded in its cToken account, `c`.

fields.name: deposited
docs: Running total of the lent mint deposited into Kamino.

fields.name: redeemed
docs: Running total of the lent mint redeemed from Kamino, in swaps, removals and
`rebalance`.

fields.name: created_slot
docs: When the market was created.

fields.name: exit_seen_slot
docs: For a market in withdraw mode, the slot of the `rebalance` that first saw Kamino's freely
available liquidity above the exit threshold, since when every `rebalance` has; 0
otherwise, as in markets created before the field was taken from the reserved space
(docs/spec/lending-pool.md, "Withdraw mode").

types.name: LentSideRemoved
docs: An LP left with the lent side alone through `remove_lent_side`, giving up the other side's
part to the LPs who stay (docs/spec/lending-pool.md, "Removing").

fields.name: shares
docs: The LP shares burned.

fields.name: share_count
docs: The market's share count after the removal, the locked minimum included.

fields.name: lent
docs: The buffer's part, paid in the lent mint.

fields.name: ctokens
docs: The cTokens' part, paid as cTokens.

fields.name: other_left
docs: The other side's part, `R x lp / N`, left in the market for the LPs who stay.

types.name: LiquidityAdded
docs: An LP added liquidity with `add_liquidity`.

fields.name: amounts
docs: What the market took of each mint, by mint index.

fields.name: shares
docs: The LP shares minted to the LP.

fields.name: share_count
docs: The market's share count after the deposit, the locked minimum included.

fields.name: first
docs: Whether this was the first deposit, which set the price.

types.name: LiquidityRemoved
docs: An LP removed liquidity with `remove_liquidity` (docs/spec/lending-pool.md, "Removing").

fields.name: shares
docs: The LP shares burned.

fields.name: share_count
docs: The market's share count after the removal, the locked minimum included.

fields.name: amounts
docs: What the LP received of each mint, by mint index: the other side's part, and of the lent
mint the buffer's part plus, in cash, what klend paid for the cTokens' part.

fields.name: ctokens
docs: The cTokens that left the market, as measured: paid to the LP in kind, burned by klend's
redeem in cash.

fields.name: in_kind
docs: Whether the cTokens' part was paid as cTokens.

fields.name: redeemed
docs: In cash, the lent mint klend's redeem paid for the cTokens' part, included in `amounts`.

types.name: MarketCreated
docs: A market was created, through the router's `create_market` or a launchpad's
`pipeline_seed_liquidity`, which then emits [`MarketSeeded`].

fields.name: mints
docs: In the creator's order.

types.name: MarketSeeded
docs: A launchpad's program seeded a new market with `pipeline_seed_liquidity`: its first deposit
came from the seeder's escrows, and its shares went to the LP recipient.

fields.name: seeder
docs: The calling program's PDA that signed, whose address scopes the market's.

fields.name: lp_recipient
docs: The owner of the shares, and the token account of the LP mint they went to: the
recipient's associated token account, the lock account when the recipient is the vault
authority.

fields.name: amounts
docs: What the market took of each mint, by mint index.

fields.name: shares
docs: The LP shares minted to the recipient.

fields.name: share_count
docs: The market's share count after the seed, the locked minimum included.

types.name: RebalanceDirection
docs: Which way a `rebalance` moved the lent mint.

types.name: Rebalanced
docs: `rebalance` moved the buffer back towards its target.

fields.name: liquidity
docs: The lent mint that actually left or joined the buffer, as measured at the vault.

fields.name: ctokens
docs: The cTokens that were actually minted to or burned from the market, as measured at its
cToken account.

fields.name: buffer
docs: The buffer `B` the market has recorded afterwards.

fields.name: ctokens_held
docs: The cTokens `c` the market has recorded afterwards.

fields.name: deposited
docs: The running totals of the lent mint deposited into and redeemed from Kamino
afterwards; the lending yield so far is `V + redeemed - deposited`.

types.name: ResolveRequest
docs: `pipeline_strategy_interface::ResolveRequest`.

types.name: SeedRequest
docs: `pipeline_strategy_interface::SeedRequest`: the most to take from each escrow, in mint
order, and the creation parameters, Borsh-encoded as [`crate::InitParams`].

types.name: SharesLocked
docs: An LP moved shares into the market's lock account with `lock_lp`, for good
(docs/spec/lending-pool.md, "Locking").

fields.name: amount
docs: The shares locked by this call.

fields.name: locked
docs: The lock account's balance afterwards: every share locked in the market so far.

fields.name: share_count
docs: The market's share count, the locked minimum included, which locking leaves unchanged.

types.name: ShortfallRedeemed
docs: A swap redeemed its shortfall from Kamino before paying the trader
(docs/spec/lending-pool.md, "Redeeming the shortfall").

fields.name: shortfall
docs: What the trade paid out beyond the buffer, `out - B`.

fields.name: ctokens
docs: The cTokens burned, `ceil(shortfall x S_ctoken / S_total)` at the stored rate, as
measured at the market's cToken account.

fields.name: liquidity
docs: The lent mint klend's redeem actually paid into the buffer vault, at least the shortfall;
anything above it stays in the buffer.

fields.name: buffer
docs: The buffer `B` the market has recorded after paying the trader.

fields.name: ctokens_held
docs: The cTokens `c` the market has recorded afterwards.

fields.name: redeemed
docs: The running total of the lent mint redeemed from Kamino afterwards.

types.name: SwapRequest
docs: `pipeline_strategy_interface::SwapRequest`.

types.name: TradeRequest
docs: `pipeline_strategy_interface::TradeRequest`.

types.name: WithdrawModeEntered
docs: `rebalance` put the market into withdraw mode: Kamino's freely available liquidity was below
`WITHDRAW_MODE_ENTER` times the market's exposure (docs/spec/lending-pool.md, "Withdraw
mode"). Emitted before the call's [`Rebalanced`], if it moved anything.

fields.name: free_liquidity
docs: The reserve's freely available liquidity `rebalance` measured.

fields.name: exposure
docs: The market's exposure `X = max(V, T)`: the larger of its lent value and its target lent
value.

types.name: WithdrawModeLeft
docs: `rebalance` took the market out of withdraw mode: Kamino's freely available liquidity was
back above `WITHDRAW_MODE_EXIT` times the market's exposure, so the band applies again.
Emitted before the call's [`Rebalanced`], if it moved anything.

fields.name: free_liquidity
docs: The reserve's freely available liquidity `rebalance` measured.

fields.name: exposure
docs: The market's exposure `X = max(V, T)`.

constants.name: ADD_MAX_RESERVE_AGE_SLOTS
docs: How many slots old the reserve's last refresh may be when `add_liquidity` values a market's
cTokens: 0, refreshed in the same slot, as klend itself asks before it states its exchange
rate. Adding and removing charge no fee, so any interest the stored rate has not counted yet
would go to whoever adds just before the reserve refreshes and leaves just after, out of the
LPs' yield (finding H001, docs/security/lending-amm/). A depositor puts klend's
`refresh_reserve` first in the same transaction. Exported in the IDL, as is the trade bound,
from which forms, keepers and the demo read them.

constants.name: BUFFER_MAX_BPS
docs: ...or above this.

constants.name: BUFFER_MIN_BPS
docs: The band: `rebalance` acts only when the buffer's share is below this...

constants.name: BUFFER_TARGET_BPS
docs: The buffer's target share of the lent side's total, in basis points: 20%. Exported in the
IDL, as is the band, from which forms, keepers and the demo read them.

constants.name: MAX_LP_FEE_BPS
docs: The highest LP fee a market may charge, in basis points: 2%. Exported in the IDL, from
which forms and the demo read it.

constants.name: MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY
docs: LP base units the first deposit locks for good: counted in every market's share count
and never minted. Exported in the IDL, from which the demo reads it.

constants.name: TRADE_MAX_RESERVE_AGE_SLOTS
docs: How many slots old the reserve's last refresh may be when a quote or a swap values a market's
cTokens: about an hour. A trade at the stored rate and one back after a refresh pay Pipeline's
fee twice, 0.5%, besides the LP fee, which may be 0; an hour of interest at the steepest rate
the deploy sees, our devnet reserves' 1,000% a year, is about 0.11%, so no such round trip
pays. Beyond it a trader, a keeper or Aviary puts klend's `refresh_reserve` first.

constants.name: WITHDRAW_MODE_ENTER
docs: Enter withdraw mode when Kamino's freely available liquidity is below this many times
the larger of the market's lent value and its target lent value. Exported in the IDL, as is
the exit multiple, from which keepers and the demo read them. It must not be above
`WITHDRAW_MODE_EXIT`, which `crate::withdraw_mode` checks when the program is built.

constants.name: WITHDRAW_MODE_EXIT
docs: Leave withdraw mode when it is back above this many times that amount.

constants.name: WITHDRAW_MODE_EXIT_DELAY_SLOTS
docs: How many slots a market in withdraw mode must have seen Kamino's freely available liquidity
above the exit threshold before it leaves: about an hour. Any `rebalance` in between that sees
it at or below the threshold starts the wait again. One reading can be inflated at no risk, by
a deposit and a redeem around `rebalance` in one Jito bundle, which would lend the market's
liquidity into a crunch; readings an hour apart, with the keeper's sweeps between them, cannot
(finding H004, docs/security/lending-amm/). Exported in the IDL, from which keepers read it.
